findings.summary: Reused the compiler's NativeHostUi schema and one parsed scene manifest instead of maintaining duplicate capture/parity representations and reads.
Replaced FontChoice and literal filesystem probes with one platform font resolver backed by DirectWrite, CoreText, and fontconfig, including nullable platform API guards.
Replaced the target-specific Tetris width constant with bounded retained max-content measurement for any marked shrink-to-fit element and shared the inline-level display predicate.
Limited intrinsic remeasurement to tree or display-density changes and restored projected width declarations exactly after the measurement pass.
Added an architecture assertion that rejects FontChoice, manual filesystem probing, and font path/file literals across the RmlUi projection, resolver, header, and CMake wiring.
Parsed BBLITE_CAPTURE_UI once in shared FrameOptions instead of repeating environment reads in the four SDL_GPU and Dawn scene/sprite loops.
